rawSource.ability: 3 [Wave] if no tokens on this fish
rawSource.description: Unlike some anglerfishes, the tiny males of this deepsea blackdevil are not believed to be parasitic.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Abyssal Halosaur
rawSource.description: It often hovers just above the seafloor, pectoral fins held erect and pointing forward, possibly serving a sensory function.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Abyssal Spiderfish
rawSource.description: Underwater images have shown the trails made when this fish “walks” over the seafloor on its pelvic and tail fins.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Angelshark
rawSource.ability: 10 [Wave] if [ConsumeFish3] (there are 3+ fish under this one)
rawSource.description: The angelshark is an ambush predator, camouflaging itself on the sea floor until prey gets close.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Angler
rawSource.description: The angler uses a special dorsal fin ray to lure passing fish near its mouth, gulping them down.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Arabian Carpetshark
rawSource.description: This hardy shark inhabits coastal waters that feature coral reefs, lagoons, rocky shores, and mangrove estuaries.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
rawSource.description: The bluefin tuna is one of the open ocean’s fastest and strongest predators, reaching speeds of up to 69 km/hr.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Bonito
rawSource.ability: 6 [Wave] if [ConsumeFish2] (there are 2+ fish under this one)
rawSource.description: The Atlantic bonito uses ram ventilation, meaning that it must keep swimming to breathe. It swallows prey whole.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Mackerel
rawSource.description: Unlike other mackerel, this fish does not leap out of the water unless it’s attempting to escape a predator.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Sailfish
rawSource.description: The Atlantic sailfish hunts schooling fish, such as sardines, anchovies, and mackerel, utilizing its pointed bill.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Salmon
rawSource.description: Atlantic salmon go out to sea to grow. Then they return to the river where they were born to spawn.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Sturgeon
rawSource.description: Its eggs are prized as high-quality caviar, and now it is threatened by overfishing, pollution, and habitat loss.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Wolffish
rawSource.description: Males of this species guard new eggs, hardly feeding as they do. Their bite can crush the hard shells of mollusks.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Banggai Cardinalfish
rawSource.description: Due to limited geographical diversity and its popularity in the aquarium trade, this fish has become endangered.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Barramundi
rawSource.description: Virtually all barramundi are born male, then turn female when they are three to four years old.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bearded Seadevil
rawSource.description: Bearded seadevils attract prey with their bioluminescent lure and elaborate bioluminescent chin barbel.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bigeye Tuna
rawSource.description: This fish dives deep during the day and returns to surface waters by nightfall, a 20ºC difference in temperature.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bigeye Smooth-Head
rawSource.description: The genus was first discovered in 1911 off the coast of the Baja California peninsula, where its Latin name comes from.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Binocular Fish
rawSource.description: Binocular fish have highly developed tubular eyes that face forward in their transparent heads.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Black Cardinalfish
rawSource.description: Found in most temperate oceans, this species is believed to have a lifespan of over 100 years.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Black Hagfish
rawSource.description: Hagfish produce copious amounts of expanding slime that can fill even the largest predator’s mouth and gills.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Black Swallower
rawSource.description: It can swallow prey up to ten times its size, coiling the other fish inside its distended stomach.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Blob Sculpin
rawSource.description: Named the world’s ugliest animal in 2013, the “blobfish” soared to fame through memes, songs, toys, and cartoons.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Blue Tang
rawSource.description: When in danger, it raises a pair of venomous spines on either side of its tail, then whips its body back and forth.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bluespine Unicornfish
rawSource.description: The horn-like appendage between its eyes starts growing when the fish reaches about 13 cm in length.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bluestreak Cleaner Wrasse
rawSource.description: These fish set up cleaning stations to remove and eat unwanted ectoparasites on “client” fish.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bluntnose Sixgill Shark
rawSource.description: One of the world’s largest sharks, it appears similar to fossilized remains dating back roughly 200 million years

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Chinese Trumpetfish
rawSource.description: This solitary fish often darts down vertically to hunt, using suction to draw prey into its elongated, tubular snout.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Chola Guitarfish
rawSource.description: Found on shallow, soft bottoms, this fish gets its common name from its guitar-like shape.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Clown Anemonefish
rawSource.description: Living within an anemone in a symbiotic relationship, the two creatures defend each other from predators.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Common Fangtooth
rawSource.description: They have opposing sockets on either side of their brain to accommodate their fangs when their mouth is closed.

abilityText.raw: 5 [Wave] if [PlayFishBottomRow] (this fish is in the bottom row)

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Cookiecutter Shark
rawSource.ability: 5 [Wave] if [PlayFishBottomRow] (this fish is in the bottom row)
rawSource.description: It is called a cookiecutter shark because it takes a perfectly round, cookie-sized plug of flesh from its prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Cownose Ray
rawSource.description: Its common name comes from the shape of its head, which resembles a cow nose when seen from above.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Creolefish
rawSource.description: A relatively short snout gives it binocular vision. When it sees danger, it retreats rapidly into rocks or a reef.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Crocodilefish
rawSource.description: Its eyes have iris lappets, pale projections that resemble eyelashes and provide camouflage for the black pupils.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Deepsea Lizardfish
rawSource.description: It rests on the seafloor, head slightly elevated, ready to strike any prey that comes close—even its own kind.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Diamond Stingray
rawSource.description: Common near beaches, it’s not aggressive, but its long, venomous tail spine can still be dangerous to people.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Elsman's Whipnose
rawSource.description: It has a long whip-like lure attached to the tip of its snout, and approximately five rows of needle-like teeth.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Emperor Red Snapper
rawSource.description: It is a snapper, not an emperor fish. Juveniles will often shelter among sea urchin spines for protection.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Escolar
rawSource.description: The flesh of this fish is very oily, which makes it delicious to humans but dangerous to consume in large quantities.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: European Anchovy
rawSource.description: It is euryhaline, meaning it can live in water with low salinity, such as lagoons, estuaries, and brackish lakes.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: European Flounder
rawSource.description: The flounder can be found in the sea, in estuaries, and even sometimes in freshwater rivers.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: European Sturgeon
rawSource.description: Once abundant and found in many coastal habitats around Europe, it is now a critically endangered species.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Faceless Cusk
rawSource.description: First collected by the HMS Challenger in 1878, the so-called “faceless fish” was not rediscovered until 2017.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: False Catshark
rawSource.description: Even though it has long, narrow, catlike eyes, it is not a catshark. It’s much larger and has hundreds of tiny teeth.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: False Cleanerfish
rawSource.description: It mimics the cleaner wrasse and then takes a bite out of the unexpecting fish waiting for a cleaning.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Flabby Whalefish
rawSource.description: The tiny males, once believed to be members of a different family, look quite different than the females and do not feed as adults.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Footballfish
rawSource.description: The modified ray on its head makes a thick fishing rod, tipped with a luminous bulb, used to lure prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Devil Ray
rawSource.description: Devil rays get their common name from the twin horns on their head that are actually fins used to help them feed.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Hatchetfish
rawSource.description: Through the use of bioluminescence, this fish can both make itself appear invisible and find other fish more easily.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Hawkfish
rawSource.description: Named for its hawklike hunting technique, it perches on the high point of a coral reef and dives down upon prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Manta Ray
rawSource.description: The largest ray in the world, it has the biggest brain of any fish by volume—ten times larger than a whale shark’s.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Oarfish
rawSource.description: Rarely seen, the oarfish is the world’s longest bony fish. It’s believed to be the cause of sea serpent sightings.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Trevally
rawSource.description: The giant trevally is known to prey upon fledgling seabirds that fall into the water while learning to fly.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Gray Triggerfish
rawSource.description: Its first, tall dorsal spine remains erect until the smaller second spine is deflexed, triggering the first.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Great Northern Tilefish
rawSource.description: This colorful fish is known as the clown of the sea. It burrows into the sediment at the bottom of the ocean.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Great White Shark
rawSource.description: Known by scientists as simply the “white shark,” this famous predator is, itself, occasionally preyed upon by orca whales.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Greenland Shark
rawSource.description: This shark currently holds the record as the longest-lived vertebrate, with an estimated lifespan of over 250 years.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Grideye Fish
rawSource.description: Its eyes are flat, cornea-like, light-sensitive organs without lenses that cover most of the upper surface of the head.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Haddock
rawSource.description: It lives on gravelly, sandy, and pebbly seafloors, where it feeds on small fish, worms, mollusks, and eggs.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Hogfish
rawSource.description: Its common name comes from its long pig-like snout and how it roots around the seafloor searching for food.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Honeycomb Scaly Dragonfish
rawSource.description: This fish can be found in deep waters during the day and in shallower areas at night, where it searches for food.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Humpback Anglerfish
rawSource.description: The humpback anglerfish is more commonly found at shallower depths than other species in its genus.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Humphead Wrasse
rawSource.description: It excavates by ejecting water to displace sand. Then it noses around for food.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Indo-Pacific Sailfish
rawSource.description: The world’s fastest swimming fish, its intricate dorsal fin, shaped like a sail, helps it to reach up to 110 km per hour.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Japanese Anchovy
rawSource.description: Large schools tend to swim close to the surface during the full moon, their silver scales shimmering in the light.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Kaluga
rawSource.description: Endangered throughout its range from overfishing, this sturgeon spends much of its life in estuaries and rivers.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Kawakawa
rawSource.description: Adults live in open waters but remain close to the shoreline. Their young may enter bays and harbors.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Largetooth Flounder
rawSource.description: The largetooth flounder is a species of left- eyed flatfish with both eyes of the adult on the left side of its body.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Leafy Seadragon
rawSource.description: Lobes of skin growing all over it provide camouflage, giving it the appearance of seaweed, even as it swims.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Little Skate
rawSource.description: Its tail contains an organ that intermittently generates a weak electric field that may be used for communication.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Live Sharksucker
rawSource.description: This fish can attach itself to any large host, even scuba divers, using the oval-shaped sucking disc on its head.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Long-Snouted Lancetfish
rawSource.description: Voracious eaters, many new species of fish and mollusks have been discovered in the contents of their stomachs.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Longspine Porcupinefish
rawSource.description: It uses its beak and the plates on the roof of its mouth to crush prey that would otherwise be indigestible.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Mahi-Mahi
rawSource.description: Its common name means “strong-strong” in Hawaiian. Flyingfishes make up nearly 25% of the diet of adults.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Maltese Ray
rawSource.description: Critically endangered due to habitat loss, the Maltese ray faces a high risk of extinction in the wild.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Mariana Snailfish
rawSource.description: It has been observed at a depth of 8,178 m, making it one of the deepest dwelling fishes on the planet.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Mediterranean Damselfish
rawSource.description: Though normally a peaceful species, males aggressively guard the eggs while they develop.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Mediterranean Parrotfish
rawSource.description: It starts life as female, then changes to male in adulthood, turning from bright red and yellow to gray and blue.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Midwater Scorpionfish
rawSource.description: This fish has often been seen suspending itself vertically in the water, with its mouth pointing up towards the surface.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Ocean Sunfish
rawSource.description: The largest known bony fish, it basks on the surface to thermally recharge after feeding in deeper, colder waters.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Oceanic Puffer
rawSource.description: Its Latin name means “rabbit head,” and, like many puffers, it contains neurotoxins that may be fatal to humans if eaten.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pacific Sardine
rawSource.description: Forming schools of up to 10 million fish, it is, at times, the most abundant species in the California Current.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pacific White Skate
rawSource.description: Most skates only have dermal denticles on their dorsal side, but this one has tiny spines on its belly as well.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pale Chimaera
rawSource.description: Dubbed “ghost sharks,” chimaeras “flap” their large pectoral fins to propel themselves forward (unlike sharks).

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Paintspotted Moray
rawSource.description: It inhabits reef flats and rocky intertidal shorelines, and it will sometimes leave the water in pursuit of prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Paraliparis
rawSource.description: This species does not have a common name of its own. It’s a snailfish—scaleless with a thin, loose, gelatinous skin.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Patagonian Toothfish
rawSource.description: Antifreeze proteins prevent its blood and tissues from freezing in subzero temperatures.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pelican Eel
rawSource.description: The mouth of the pelican eel can open wide enough to swallow prey much larger than the eel itself.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pennant Coralfish
rawSource.description: The juveniles are solitary and sometimes clean parasites off other, larger fish. Adults live in pairs and feed on zooplankton.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pilotfish
rawSource.description: This carnivorous fish tends to follow sharks and ships to feed on parasites and leftover scraps of food.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Plate Fish
rawSource.description: Plate fish are experts at camouflage and can quickly change colors to match their surroundings.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pudgy Cusk-Eel
rawSource.description: The pudgy cusk-eel is a common fish of deep oceans. It lives along the ocean floor as deep as 4,300 m.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Pygmy Seahorse
rawSource.description: It is nearly indistinguishable from the coral where it is found because of its tiny size and specialized camouflage.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Red Lionfish
rawSource.description: Though it is a staple in the aquarium fish trade and a popular attraction for divers, this fish is quite venomous.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Red Scorpionfish
rawSource.description: A lurking fish that uses camouflage to surprise its food, the spines of its dorsal fin house potent venom glands.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Rockmover Wrasse
rawSource.description: To expose its prey, it will overturn rocks. If threatened, it will dive into the sand and wriggle its way to safety.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sailfin Flying Fish
rawSource.description: When they leave the water, they can fly up to 400 meters at speeds of up to 70 km per hour.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sargassum Fish
rawSource.description: Sargassum fish spend most of their life drifting with the floating seaweed mats where they live and hunt.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Scaleless Black Dragonfish
rawSource.description: It has a fleshy bioluminescent barbel at its chin, used to lure prey within reach of its heavily toothed mouth.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Shortspine African Angler
rawSource.description: The color of its body changes to match its surroundings. It can fully swallow prey as large as itself.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Shortspine Spurdog
rawSource.description: A type of dogfish found along the continental shelves, it gives birth to live young after a two-year gestation period.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Silver Lightfish
rawSource.description: Rows of violet light organs run along its belly, and each eye has additional light organs in front and behind it.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Skipjack Tuna
rawSource.description: Skipjack makes up about 70% of all canned or pouched tuna. It is the most caught tuna in the world.

rawSource.name: Sloan's Viperfish
